hook_line: INDIA-TRAINED DOCTOR TO LEAD WASHU PEDIATRICS

hook_stat.sub: Starts as pediatrics chair at WashU Medicine and pediatrician-in-chief at St. Louis Children's Hospital

stats.label: Years at Massachusetts General Hospital before chairing pediatrics at UVA
Has held the presidency of the Pediatric Endocrine Society

diaspora_bullets: Medical degree in Odisha, residency in New York, fellowship at Massachusetts General Hospital
An India-trained physician-scientist takes a top US pediatrics post
news_summary: Madhusmita Misra has been named chair of the Edward Mallinckrodt Department of Pediatrics at Washington University School of Medicine and pediatrician-in-chief at St. Louis Children's Hospital, starting January 4, 2027.
payoff: A doctor who began medical school in Odisha will lead pediatrics at one of America's top-ranked medical schools.
